Head_and_Face: Bill is distinctive with downward-curving shape, deep black at tip transitioning to pale pink at base.
Head is small relative to extremely elongated neck.
Eyes are dark and positioned on small head.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage ranges from pale pink to vivid scarlet with darker coloration on wings and tail.
Body exhibits compact torso contrasting elongated neck and legs.
Wings display black primary feathers visible during flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are exceptionally long and bright pink to red with webbed feet.
Neck is extremely elongated and S-curved comprising approximately one-third of total body length.
Flight posture features full neck extension.

Head_and_Face: Bill is long, pointed, and two-toned: grey base with black tip measuring 9-11 cm.
Head and neck are bluish-grey.
Eyes are dark and positioned on slender head.
Body_and_Plumage: Adult plumage is uniform bluish-grey with darker slate-blue body and lighter grey neck.
Body measures 55-76 cm with wingspan 95-100 cm.
Wings are broad with darker flight feathers creating subtle contrast.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long and greenish-yellow to grey adapted for wading.
Neck is long and S-curved, retracted in flight.
Feeding posture features slow stalking with neck extended.

Head_and_Face: Bill is long, straight, pointed, and yellow measuring 12-15 cm.
Eyes are yellow with pale lores turning greenish during breeding.
Head is entirely white with no contrasting coloration.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is entirely brilliant white with no contrasting coloration.
Elongated ornamental plumes (aigrettes) extend from back and chest during breeding season.
Body measures 85-100 cm with wingspan 130-155 cm.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long and black with yellow feet.
Neck is long and S-curved, retracted during flight creating hunched profile.
Wings are broad and entirely white with visible black legs trailing behind in flight.

Head_and_Face: Bill is long, straight, pointed, and yellowish-green with dark culmen.
Distinctive dark brown stripe runs from eye down side of neck.
Head is broad with cryptic tawny-brown coloration.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage displays cryptic tawny-brown coloration with dark brown streaks and mottling.
Body exhibits stocky proportions measuring 50-75 cm.
Broad wings and short tail provide camouflage in reed beds.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are yellowish-green and moderately long.
Neck is thick and relatively short compared to other herons.
When threatened, adopts upright freezing posture with bill pointed skyward.

Head_and_Face: Bill is long, straight, pointed, and grey to yellow.
Head displays contrasting black, white, or red facial and neck markings depending on species.
Eyes are positioned on elongated head with distinctive facial markings.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage varies by species: grey, white, or brown with contrasting markings.
Body exhibits tall, slender proportions measuring 90-150 cm.
Elongated tertial feathers create trailing appearance beyond short tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are extremely long with hind toe elevated or absent.
Neck is elongated and flexible, extended during flight unlike herons.
Wings are broad and flat measuring 150-240 cm wingspan.

Head_and_Face: Bill is long, laterally compressed, and distinctly drooping at tip, greyish-green with darker tip.
Head is small relative to body with pale yellow eye.
White streaking extends onto neck from body.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is dark brown with prominent white streaks and spots covering body, wings, and neck.
Body measures 58-71 cm with wingspan 95-105 cm.
Wings are broad with white spotting visible in flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long and greyish-brown.
Neck is moderately long with white streaking.
Body exhibits slightly hunched posture.

Head_and_Face: Red frontal shield extends from bill base onto forehead.
Bill is bright red tipped yellow.
Head and neck are glossy purple-blue with metallic sheen.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is predominantly glossy purple-blue with metallic sheen.
Body measures 38-45 cm with wingspan 90-100 cm.
Wings display greenish iridescence in flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are extremely long and yellowish-green with large unwebbed toes.
Tail is short with white undertail coverts visible when raised.
Toes adapted for walking on floating vegetation.

Head_and_Face: Bright white bill with dark brown to black frontal shield extending onto forehead.
Eyes are bright red.
Head is small and rounded relative to body.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is uniformly dark slate-grey to black with lighter grey flanks.
Body exhibits rounded, duck-like profile measuring 34-43 cm.
Wings are broad with white leading edge visible in flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are greenish-yellow with unique lobed toes (not webbed).
Each toe has flattened lobes that expand during swimming stroke and fold on recovery.
Tail is short with white undertail coverts.

Head_and_Face: Bill is short, stout, and slightly curved, greyish-brown.
Head is relatively small on long thick neck.
Male displays elaborate facial wattles during courtship.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage displays cryptic brown, grey, and buff coloration with barred and mottled patterns.
Body is robust and stocky measuring 50-120 cm.
Wings are broad and rounded with dark flight feathers contrasting lighter body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long and powerful adapted for running.
Neck is long and thick.
Tail is long and graduated.

Head_and_Face: Bill is short, wedge-shaped, and slightly upturned at tip, dark orange to black.
Head displays white eyebrow stripe and dark eye line.
Eyes are dark with distinctive facial markings.
Body_and_Plumage: Breeding plumage: chestnut-brown upperparts with black and white mottling, black breast band, white belly.
Non-breeding plumage is duller grey-brown with faint mottling.
Body measures 22-25 cm with wingspan 50-57 cm.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are bright orange-red and relatively short.
Wings are pointed with white wing bars visible in flight.
Tail is short with white edges.
